headline: "Turning point" of the 2027 Special Consumption Tax: traditional CKD assembly lines face a matter of survival
summary: Traditional CKD assembly lines in Vietnam face a price-cutting war for clearing inventory and pressure from cheap electric vehicles. The industry is also facing the 2027 special consumption tax turning point.
why: CKD assembly plants import components for local vehicle assembly, so tax and pricing changes affect automaker margins.
